tasks.Distance_Calculation_1: Calculate the total distance of the journey using speed and time.
tasks.Speed_Change_Detection: Detect when the train's speed changes due to rain.
tasks.Time_Calculation_1: Calculate the time taken for the first quarter of the journey at 100 miles/hour.
tasks.Time_Calculation_2: Calculate the remaining distance after covering a quarter and then calculate the time taken to cover it at 75 miles/hour.
tasks.Total_Time_Calculation: Sum up all the times calculated above to get the total journey duration.
